author: Rebecca Raney
title: 273-unit apartment development approved for Winterpast subdivision - NewsBreak
text:
By Rebecca Raney ,
5 hours ago
Alcoa Regional Planning Commissioners signed off on a preliminary plat for a 273-unit apartment complex off Topside Road in the Winterpast subdivision on Feb. 19.
If completed according to preliminary plat designs submitted by Tim Shaw with Hagen Engineering, the Views at Topside Apartments, located at 1528 Topside Road, will include eight three-story apartment buildings, a clubhouse and pool, a mail center, a playground, a dog park, a car wash and maintenance building, and several parking aisles throughout.
Readers may recall that the 22-acre Winterpast subdivision previously belonged to former ARPC Chair Clarence Williams, who helped advocate for it to be annexed into the city of Alcoa and later subdivided into four distinct lots. The largest of these ‚Äî Lot 1, at just over 15 acres ‚Äî is where developers intend to place the apartment buildings and ancillary structures commissioners approved. Lots 2 and 3, both around 3 acres each, are being held ‚Äúfor future commercial development,‚Äù while the T-shaped Lot 4 will be used to construct common drive aisles, an internal private roadway, and connections to Topside Road and East Old Topside Road.
With the Elevate at Topside and Topside 333 complexes roughly one mile to the south, the Views development is expected to bring the total number of new residential units in the area to 781. Early mock-ups appear to show a design similar to that of the Elevate buildings.
Other business
Commissioners also approved a site plan from William Robinson with Will Robinson & Associates for a new two-building industrial warehouse development in the Northpark Industrial Park. Situated on just over 4 acres of land at 3100 Northpark Blvd., each building is planned to be approximately 17,000 square feet.
Staff noted developers will be responsible for working with both the city of Alcoa and the Tennessee Department of Transportation to ensure the new buildings and roadways comply with a nearby state right of way.
The following also was approved:
A plat of correction from David Mullins with Civil Environmental Consultants Inc. to capture utility easements and site improvements at Hickory Workforce Development, 125 Kent Place.
Two revised site plans from Corey Boss with Michael Graves Architecture & Design Inc. One was for exterior modifications at a commercial building in Topside Square, 2132 Topside Road, and the other was for a corporate condo ownership development at 246 N. Rankin Road between Alcoa Dermatology and Alcoa Chiropractic.
